title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Composition of the Audit and Assurance Standards Committee)
(1) The Audit and Assurance Standards Committee (hereinafter referred to as "the Committee"), consisting of 11 members, including one chairperson, shall be composed of members considering gender balance.
(2) The chairperson of the Committee shall be elected from among the members who are not those specified in paragraph (1) and (2).
(3) The members of the Committee shall be individuals who possess professional knowledge and ethical conduct necessary for the proper performance of their duties related to accounting, as specified in paragraph (5) of Article 3.
(4) The members of the Committee shall be appointed or nominated by the President of the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants (KICPA) from among the individuals who meet the qualifications specified in paragraph (3). However, the members specified in paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not be subject to paragraph (3).
1. One permanent member nominated by the President of the KICPA
2. One head of a relevant accounting department nominated by the Director of the Financial Supervisory Service
3. One person selected from among those specified in the following:
    a. A member of the Korean Institute of Accountants

1. One recommended member from the following:
    a. A researcher from a recognized research institution in the field of finance or accounting.
    b. A professor or associate professor teaching finance or accounting at a university.
2. Two recommended members from the following certified public accountants, as recommended by the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants:
    a. Certified public accountants employed by accounting firms with 500 or more members.
    b. Certified public accountants employed by accounting firms or audit firms with fewer than 500 members.
3. One recommended member from the following certified public accountants, who are not employed by an accounting firm or audit firm:
    a. The Chairman of the Korea Securities & Exchange Commission.
    b. The Chairman of the Korea Exchange.
    c. The Chairman of the Korea Federation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry.
4. The Chairman of the Korean Bar Association, as established under Article 78 of the "Legal Practitioners Act," shall recommend one lawyer with expertise in the field of finance or accounting.
⑤ Regarding the disqualification of members, Article 3, Paragraph 6 shall apply.
⑥ If the Chairman is unable to perform his duties for any reason, the duties shall be performed in the order of appointment or designation as a member.

⑦ The terms of office for the members of items 3 to 6 of Article 4 shall be 2 years, and they may be re-appointed for only one term. However, even if their terms of office expire, they may continue to perform their duties until a successor is appointed.
⑧ In addition to the matters stipulated in Articles 1 to 7, the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants shall determine any other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Audit Committee.
